verses.1: Hear what Jehovah says: “Arise, and raise up the mountains; let them hear your voice.”
verses.2: May the mountains hear the anger of the LORD, and may all people on earth hear His judgment. For there is a great wrath against the LORD over Israel and its people.
verses.3: What have I done to you? What do you want me to say in response?
verses.4: For you have been taken up from the land of Egypt, and from being slaves. I will send Moses and Aaron before you.
verses.5: O my people, remember what Mordecai said to King Ahab. Remember also how he answered him in the wilderness, from among the strangers until the end of time, so that his righteousness might be known by Jehovah.
verses.6: Let us march forward, O LORD! Let us be led by the way in those hills and valleys. May the children of the year lead us along.
verses.7: May the LORD desire thousands of sheep in the valleys of Shechem. These are given to me as a punishment for my sins and transgressions.
verses.8: Let me tell you what is good, and what Jehovah requires of you. It is to do justice, to love kindness, and to be humble in your dealings with your God.
verses.9: The voice of the LORD shall be heard in the city; it shall bring peace and joy. They will hear Your name. Who can stop them?
verses.10: The wicked still live in their houses, committing evil deeds and spreading hatred.
verses.11: He will receive what he deserves from the ears of the wicked, and in the pockets of the deceitful people.
verses.12: Their riches are filled with hypocrisy, and their words are lies. They deceive others with their deceitful talk.
verses.13: And I too have begun to write down your sins.
verses.14: You shall eat, but not rejoice. You shall be sad in your heart. You shall gather up what you have, and you shall not waste it. And whatever you waste will be lost.
verses.15: You will sow, and you will not cut down. You will walk along the path, and you will not plant anything. You will not pour out wine, nor will you drink it.
verses.16: And the laws of Amri will be broken, and all the actions of Beth-Ahava will be ruined. They will go away with their plans, so that I may take you as my wife. Then their kingship will be destroyed, and the shame of my people will be brought upon them.
